mapper.select: select d.season_id as seasonId, d.id as divisionId, s.series_name as seriesName, se.display_title as seasonTitle, d.division_name as divisionName, d.platform_code as platformCode, d.registration_start_time as registrationStartTime, d.registration_end_time as registrationEndTime, d.match_start_time as matchStartTime, d.match_end_time as matchEndTime, d.max_team_count as maxTeamCount, (select count(1) from basket_registration r2 where r2.division_id = d.id and r2.registration_status = 'APPROVED' and r2.is_delete = 0) as approvedTeamCount, case when d.max_team_count is null then null else greatest(d.max_team_count - (select count(1) from basket_registration r3 where r3.division_id = d.id and r3.registration_status = 'APPROVED' and r3.is_delete = 0), 0) end as remainingTeamCount, cg.grant_status as myGrantStatus, cg.team_id as grantTeamId, gt.team_name as grantTeamName, mr.registration_status as myRegistrationStatus from basket_division d inner join basket_season se on se.id = d.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 and se.publish_status = 'PUBLISHED' inner join basket_series s on s.id = se.series_id and s.is_delete = 0 left join basket_captain_grant cg on cg.division_id = d.id and cg.player_id = #{playerId} and cg.grant_status = 'ACTIVE' and cg.active_unique_key is not null and cg.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team gt on gt.id = cg.team_id and gt.is_delete = 0 left join basket_registration mr on mr.division_id = d.id and mr.captain_member_id = #{memberId} and mr.is_delete = 0 where d.is_delete = 0 and d.division_status = 'REGISTRATION_OPEN' and d.registration_mode = 'TEAM' order by d.sort_order asc, d.id desc

select r.id as registrationId, r.season_id as seasonId, r.division_id as divisionId, r.team_id as teamId, se.display_title as seasonTitle, d.division_name as divisionName, d.platform_code as platformCode, t.team_name as teamName, r.registration_status as registrationStatus, r.lineup_count as lineupCount, r.submit_time as submitTime, r.approve_time as approveTime, r.reject_reason as rejectReason from basket_registration r left join basket_season se on se.id = r.season_id and se.is_delete = 0 left join basket_division d on d.id = r.division_id and d.is_delete = 0 left join basket_team t on t.id = r.team_id and t.is_delete = 0 where r.is_delete = 0 and r.captain_member_id = #{memberId} order by r.update_time desc, r.id desc
select count(1) from basket_registration where division_id = #{divisionId} and registration_status = 'APPROVED' and is_delete = 0
